o.text: Borrowed from Russian голубо́й (golubój), whence also the semantic loan mavi (“light blue; homosexual”).
From Ottoman Turkish صحنه (sahne, “scene, stage”), an Ottoman coinage using صحن (sahn) + ـه (-e), the first part being derived from Arabic صَحْن (ṣaḥn). By surface analysis, səhn + -ə.

Borrowed from Classical Persian سُوءِ قَصْد (sū'-i qasd). Izāfa of سُوء (sū', “mis-”) + قَصْد (“intention”), literally “misintention”. Cognate with Turkish suikast, Uzbek suiqasd, Uyghur سۈيقەست (süyqest).
By surface analysis, sui- + qəsd.
